name: Sylvan-Strath
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by an ancient meteor crater. Beyond magnetic pole anomalies, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Instruments disagree about the temporal distortion zone: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
